Name: Caroline Portrait - Seasonal Spring Alternatif
Author: BakteriGanteng
Description:
[color=#d4d4d8]✨ Caroline - Seasonal Spring Alternative (SCA)[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
Give Caroline a stunning wardrobe update for the spring season! This mod provides a bolder, more alluring, and slightly more "spicy" alternative outfit for Caroline, designed to fit right into the **Seasonal Cute Aesthetic (SCA)** style for those warmer days in Pelican Town.

---
#📂 How it Works / Installation
Since this is a simple texture replacement mod:
1. Make sure you have the base Seasonal Cute Aesthetic mod (along with its dependencies like Content Patcher) installed.
2. Download my PNG file.
3. Simply drop and replace the original Caroline Spring PNG file inside your Seasonal Cute Aesthetic folder.
4. Enjoy your new look in-game!
